command.reload.title: Reload Snippet Files
command.showMatches.title: Show Matching Rules for Current File
config.rules.description: Rules that gate snippet files by file path. For the file being edited, its path relative to its workspace folder (with `/` separators) is tested against each rule's `patterns` (regular expressions, OR). When a rule matches, the snippets in its `snippetFile` (a path relative to the same workspace folder) are offered as completion candidates. Rules whose snippet file does not exist in that folder are silently skipped.
config.rules.patterns.description: Regular expressions tested against the workspace-relative file path (for example `\.test\.ts$` or `^src/components/`). The rule matches when any one pattern matches.
config.rules.snippetFile.description: Path of a `.code-snippets` file, relative to the workspace folder (for example `.vscode/snipgate/test.code-snippets`).
config.title: SnipGate-Solo
extension.description: Show snippets only where they belong. Define rules in settings.json — regular expressions matched against the workspace-relative file path — and each rule points to a snippet file: its snippets appear as candidates only in files that match. Missing files in a multi-root folder are skipped silently.
